newsitem.title: USA: American Brands reorganizes units. [CORRECTED 22:24 GMT]
newsitem.headline: American Brands reorganizes units. [CORRECTED 22:24 GMT]

text.p: American Brands Inc said on Monday that it is reorganizing its hardware and home improvement and office products operations under unified leadership.
Norman Wesley will have responsibility as chairman and chief executive for MasterBrand Industries, the hardware and home improvement group, and ACCO World office supplies, the company said.
Randall Larrimore resigned as president and chief executive of MasterBrand to take an executive position outside the company (corrects to make clear Randall Larrimore's position).
American Brands said the home improvement and office products businesses are becoming increasingly similar in customer expectations, manufacturing, and distribution.

The combined home and office products operations represent half of the company's proforma operating profits, American Brands said. Proforma operating profits reflect completion of the pending spinoff of its U.K. based Gallaher tobacco business to shareholders, American Brands said.
Following the spinoff, American Brands will change its name to Fortune Brands, the company said.
